items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: From the design and editorial side Bobby Reed does the final approval. So basically the designer, the editor, they do their final approval on their side of the job. The job comes to me and then I do my final approval on that.

ctx.x: There’s different levels of it. I do the final approval on everything. From the design and editorial side Bobby Reed does the final approval. So basically the designer, the editor, they do their final approval on their side of the job. The job comes to me and then I do my final approval on that. So I’m approving their work in essence.
Okay. Do you have an opinion on the state of jazz?
